# Content-addressed LLM output cache

Provides a simple content-addressed cache for LLM outputs keyed by a SHA-256 of template/version/model/input. It exposes get and put operations to read cached outputs or persist new immutable entries into the underlying SQL storage.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/cache.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.cache.LLMCache.get`
- `knowledge_compiler/llm/cache.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.cache.LLMCache.put`
